overview: The commission approved several traffic safety and parking measures, including a new four-way stop at Warren Street and Cooley Road and a 15-minute parking zone in Medford Square. The body also implemented parking restrictions on Brookside Parkway to deter dumping and tabled a request regarding church parking permits to investigate enforcement technology.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the November 12, 2024, meeting.

items.title: 2024-68: Blue Fuji Restaurant 15-Minute Parking
items.summary: Approved a 15-minute parking zone on Ashland Street adjacent to the restaurant to replace capacity lost during recent street reconstruction.

items.title: 2024-69: Brookside Parkway No Parking
items.summary: Approved 'no parking anytime' on the east side of Brookside Parkway for 200 feet south of Webster Street to mitigate persistent illegal dumping and trash buildup.

items.title: 2024-70: Seventh-day Adventist Church Parking
items.summary: Tabled for 30 days a request for church-member parking exemptions on permit-only streets to allow staff to research the technical feasibility of license plate-based enforcement.

items.title: 2024-71: Warren Street and Cooley Road Four-Way Stop
items.summary: Approved converting the intersection of Warren Street and Cooley Road to a four-way stop and directed the removal of sight-line obstructions.

items.title: Old Business and Tabled Items
items.summary: Removed items 2021-19, 2021-20, and 2023-51 from the agenda as they were previously resolved or withdrawn, while item 2024-55 remained tabled pending further outreach.
